import.csvLabel: Pakia faili la CSV au vCard
import.csvHint: CSV yetu (Jina, Simu, Kikundi, Idadi), CSV ya Google Contacts au vCard (.vcf) ya iPhone
import.notCsv: Faili hili halisomeki kama CSV au vCard

contacts.thisPhoneHelp: Chagua watu moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye simu yako.
contacts.googleHelp: Google itakuuliza ruhusa ya kusoma tu. Tunaifuta mara tu tunapomaliza kusoma.
contacts.fileHelp: iPhone au iCloud: icloud.com/contacts → Hamisha vCard. Google: contacts.google.com → Hamisha. Android: Anwani → Hamisha kwenda faili la .vcf.
contacts.tooLarge: Faili ni kubwa mno (zaidi ya MB 5)
contacts.privacy: Anwani zako zinasomwa kwenye kifaa hiki tu. Tunahifadhi jina na namba ya wale tu unaowachagua.
contacts.googleDenied: Google haikutoa ruhusa. Jaribu tena au tumia faili.
contacts.googleFailed: Imeshindikana kusoma anwani za Google. Tafadhali jaribu tena.
contacts.permPhone: Ruhusu Kadi Sasa kusoma anwani kwenye mipangilio ya simu, au bandika orodha badala yake.
contacts.limited: Umeruhusu baadhi ya anwani tu. Unaweza kuruhusu zaidi kwenye mipangilio ya simu.
contacts.readHelp: Kadi Sasa itaomba ruhusa ya kusoma anwani. Hakuna kinachotumwa mpaka uthibitishe.

import.csvLabel: Upload a CSV or vCard file
import.csvHint: Our CSV (Name, Phone, Group, Party), a Google Contacts CSV or an iPhone vCard (.vcf)
import.notCsv: This file can't be read as CSV or vCard

contacts.thisPhoneHelp: Pick people straight from your phone.
contacts.googleHelp: Google will ask you for read-only access. We remove it as soon as we have finished reading.
contacts.fileHelp: iPhone or iCloud: icloud.com/contacts → Export vCard. Google: contacts.google.com → Export. Android: Contacts → Export to .vcf file.
contacts.notContacts: This file has no readable contacts
contacts.tooLarge: The file is too large (over 5 MB)
contacts.privacy: Your contacts are read on this device only. We keep the name and number only of the people you pick.
contacts.googleDenied: Google did not grant access. Try again or use a file.
contacts.googleFailed: Couldn't read your Google contacts. Please try again.
contacts.permPhone: Allow Kadi Sasa to read contacts in your phone settings, or paste a list instead.
contacts.limited: You allowed only some contacts. You can allow more in your phone settings.
contacts.readHelp: Kadi Sasa will ask for permission to read your contacts. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
